ResearchProjectDef.label: Iratus xenopharmacology
ResearchProjectDef.description: Turn comparative study of Iratus feeding biology into usable medicine. Careful sampling of living specimens isolates regenerative and neuromuscular secretions without destroying the organism, while drug-lab stabilization converts those secretions into a powerful short-duration paralytic. This is the first practical Iratus-derived pharmacology node; restorative and hybrid applications require later research.
